name: Utah Valley Open 2023

venue.name: Spanish Fork Fairgrounds Ponderosa Building
venue.address: 2409, 475 S Main St, Spanish Fork, UT 84660
venue.details: The venue is located just south of the indoor tennis courts in the Spanish Fork Fairgrounds.

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UtahValleyOpen2023#30210-competitor-responsibilities) tab. 

For questions regarding deadlines, registrations, and the competition waitlist, please see the [Registration and Waistlist Info](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UtahValleyOpen2023#30209-registration-and-waitlist-info) tab. 


Go to our [link tree](https://linktr.ee/utahcubing) to find links to our Facebook group , Instagram page, and website, as well as the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!
